391     def _format_bedrock_messages(self, messages: Messages) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
392         """Format messages for Bedrock API compatibility.
393 
394         This function ensures messages conform to Bedrock's expected format by:
395         - Filtering out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks
396         - Eagerly filtering content blocks to only include Bedrock-supported fields
397         - Ensuring all message content blocks are properly formatted for the Bedrock API
398         - Optionally wrapping the last user message in guardrailConverseContent blocks
399         - Injecting cache points when cache_config is set with strategy="auto"
400 
401         Args:
402             messages: List of messages to format
403 
404         Returns:
405             Messages formatted for Bedrock API compatibility
406 
407         Note:
408             Unlike other APIs that ignore unknown fields, Bedrock only accepts a strict
409             subset of fields for each content block type and throws validation exceptions
410             when presented with unexpected fields. Therefore, we must eagerly filter all
411             content blocks to remove any additional fields before sending to Bedrock.
412             https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ContentBlock.html
413         """
414         cleaned_messages: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
415 
416         filtered_unknown_members = False
417         dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content = False
418 
419         # Pre-compute the index of the last user message containing text or image content.
420         # This ensures guardContent wrapping is maintained across tool execution cycles, where
421         # the final message in the list is a toolResult (role=user) rather than text/image content.
422         last_user_text_idx = None
423         if self.config.get("guardrail_latest_message", False):
424             last_user_text_idx = self._find_last_user_text_message_index(messages)
425 
426         for idx, message in enumerate(messages):
427             cleaned_content: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
428 
429             for content_block in message["content"]:
430                 # Filter out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks
431                 if "SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER" in content_block:
432                     filtered_unknown_members = True
433                     continue
434 
435                 # DeepSeek models have issues with reasoningContent
436                 # TODO: Replace with systematic model configuration registry (https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/issues/780)
437                 if "deepseek" in self.config["model_id"].lower() and "reasoningContent" in content_block:
438                     dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content = True
439                     continue
440 
441                 # Format content blocks for Bedrock API compatibility
442                 formatted_content = self._format_request_message_content(content_block)
443                 if formatted_content is None:
444                     continue
445 
446                 # Wrap text or image content in guardContent if this is the last user text/image message
447                 if idx == last_user_text_idx and ("text" in formatted_content or "image" in formatted_content):
448                     if "text" in formatted_content:
449                         formatted_content = {"guardContent": {"text": {"text": formatted_content["text"]}}}
450                     elif "image" in formatted_content:
451                         formatted_content = {"guardContent": {"image": formatted_content["image"]}}
452 
453                 cleaned_content.append(formatted_content)
454 
455             # Create new message with cleaned content (skip if empty)
456             if cleaned_content:
457                 cleaned_messages.append({"content": cleaned_content, "role": message["role"]})
458 
459         if filtered_unknown_members:
460             logger.warning(
461                 "Filtered out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks from messages, consider upgrading boto3 version"
462             )
463         if dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content:
464             logger.debug(
465                 "Filtered DeepSeek reasoningContent content blocks from messages - https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/reasoning_model#multi-round-conversation"
466             )
467 
468         # Inject cache point into cleaned_messages (not original messages) if cache_config is set
469         cache_config = self.config.get("cache_config")
470         if cache_config:
471             strategy: str | None = cache_config.strategy
472             if strategy == "auto":
473                 strategy = self._cache_strategy
474                 if not strategy:
475                     logger.warning(
476                         "model_id=<%s> | cache_config is enabled but this model does not support automatic caching",
477                         self.config.get("model_id"),
478                     )
479             if strategy == "anthropic":
480                 self._inject_cache_point(cleaned_messages)
481 
482         return cleaned_messages

507     def _format_request_message_content(self, content: ContentBlock) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
508         """Format a Bedrock content block.
509 
510         Bedrock strictly validates content blocks and throws exceptions for unknown fields.
511         This function extracts only the fields that Bedrock supports for each content type.
512 
513         Args:
514             content: Content block to format.
515 
516         Returns:
517             Bedrock formatted content block.
518 
519         Raises:
520             TypeError: If the content block type is not supported by Bedrock.
521         """
522         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_CachePointBlock.html
523         if "cachePoint" in content:
524             return {"cachePoint": {"type": content["cachePoint"]["type"]}}
525 
526         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_DocumentBlock.html
527         if "document" in content:
528             document = content["document"]
529             result: dict[str, Any] = {}
530 
531             # Handle required fields (all optional due to total=False)
532             if "name" in document:
533                 result["name"] = document["name"]
534             if "format" in document:
535                 result["format"] = document["format"]
536 
537             # Handle source - supports bytes or location
538             if "source" in document:
539                 source = document["source"]
540                 formatted_document_source: dict[str, Any] | None
541                 if "location" in source:
542                     formatted_document_source = self._handle_location(source["location"])
543                     if formatted_document_source is None:
544                         return None
545                 elif "bytes" in source:
546                     formatted_document_source = {"bytes": source["bytes"]}
547                 result["source"] = formatted_document_source
548 
549             # Handle optional fields
550             if "citations" in document and document["citations"] is not None:
551                 result["citations"] = {"enabled": document["citations"]["enabled"]}
552             if "context" in document:
553                 result["context"] = document["context"]
554 
555             return {"document": result}
556 
557         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_GuardrailConverseContentBlock.html
558         if "guardContent" in content:
559             guard = content["guardContent"]
560             guard_text = guard["text"]
561             result = {"text": {"text": guard_text["text"], "qualifiers": guard_text["qualifiers"]}}
562             return {"guardContent": result}
563 
564         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ImageBlock.html
565         if "image" in content:
566             image = content["image"]
567             source = image["source"]
568             formatted_image_source: dict[str, Any] | None
569             if "location" in source:
570                 formatted_image_source = self._handle_location(source["location"])
571                 if formatted_image_source is None:
572                     return None
573             elif "bytes" in source:
574                 formatted_image_source = {"bytes": source["bytes"]}
575             result = {"format": image["format"], "source": formatted_image_source}
576             return {"image": result}
577 
578         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ReasoningContentBlock.html
579         if "reasoningContent" in content:
580             reasoning = content["reasoningContent"]
581             result = {}
582 
583             if "reasoningText" in reasoning:
584                 reasoning_text = reasoning["reasoningText"]
585                 result["reasoningText"] = {}

319     def _get_additional_request_fields(self, tool_choice: ToolChoice | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
320         """Get additional request fields, removing thinking if tool_choice forces tool use.
321 
322         Bedrock's API does not allow thinking mode when tool_choice forces tool use.
323         When forcing a tool (e.g., for structured_output retry), we temporarily disable thinking.
324 
325         Args:
326             tool_choice: The tool choice configuration.
327 
328         Returns:
329             A dict containing additionalModelRequestFields if configured, or empty dict.
330         """
331         additional_fields = self.config.get("additional_request_fields")
332         if not additional_fields:
333             return {}
334 
335         # Check if tool_choice is forcing tool use ("any" or specific "tool")
336         is_forcing_tool = tool_choice is not None and ("any" in tool_choice or "tool" in tool_choice)
337 
338         if is_forcing_tool and "thinking" in additional_fields:
339             # Create a copy without the thinking key
340             fields_without_thinking = {k: v for k, v in additional_fields.items() if k != "thinking"}
341             if fields_without_thinking:
342                 return {"additionalModelRequestFields": fields_without_thinking}
343             return {}
344 
345         return {"additionalModelRequestFields": additional_fields}

347     def _inject_cache_point(self, messages: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
348         """Inject a cache point at the end of the last user message.
349 
350         Args:
351             messages: List of messages to inject cache point into (modified in place).
352         """
353         if not messages:
354             return
355 
356         last_user_idx: int | None = None
357         for msg_idx, msg in enumerate(messages):
358             content = msg.get("content", [])
359             for block_idx, block in reversed(list(enumerate(content))):
360                 if "cachePoint" in block:
361                     del content[block_idx]
362                     logger.warning(
363                         "msg_idx=<%s>, block_idx=<%s> | stripped existing cache point (auto mode manages cache points)",
364                         msg_idx,
365                         block_idx,
366                     )
367             if msg.get("role") == "user":
368                 last_user_idx = msg_idx
369 
370         if last_user_idx is not None and messages[last_user_idx].get("content"):
371             messages[last_user_idx]["content"].append({"cachePoint": {"type": "default"}})
372             logger.debug("msg_idx=<%s> | added cache point to last user message", last_user_idx)

391     def _format_bedrock_messages(self, messages: Messages) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
392         """Format messages for Bedrock API compatibility.
393 
394         This function ensures messages conform to Bedrock's expected format by:
395         - Filtering out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks
396         - Eagerly filtering content blocks to only include Bedrock-supported fields
397         - Ensuring all message content blocks are properly formatted for the Bedrock API
398         - Optionally wrapping the last user message in guardrailConverseContent blocks
399         - Injecting cache points when cache_config is set with strategy="auto"
400 
401         Args:
402             messages: List of messages to format
403 
404         Returns:
405             Messages formatted for Bedrock API compatibility
406 
407         Note:
408             Unlike other APIs that ignore unknown fields, Bedrock only accepts a strict
409             subset of fields for each content block type and throws validation exceptions
410             when presented with unexpected fields. Therefore, we must eagerly filter all
411             content blocks to remove any additional fields before sending to Bedrock.
412             https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ContentBlock.html
413         """
414         cleaned_messages: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
415 
416         filtered_unknown_members = False
417         dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content = False
418 
419         # Pre-compute the index of the last user message containing text or image content.
420         # This ensures guardContent wrapping is maintained across tool execution cycles, where
421         # the final message in the list is a toolResult (role=user) rather than text/image content.
422         last_user_text_idx = None
423         if self.config.get("guardrail_latest_message", False):
424             last_user_text_idx = self._find_last_user_text_message_index(messages)
425 
426         for idx, message in enumerate(messages):
427             cleaned_content: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
428 
429             for content_block in message["content"]:
430                 # Filter out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks
431                 if "SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER" in content_block:
432                     filtered_unknown_members = True
433                     continue
434 
435                 # DeepSeek models have issues with reasoningContent
436                 # TODO: Replace with systematic model configuration registry (https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/issues/780)
437                 if "deepseek" in self.config["model_id"].lower() and "reasoningContent" in content_block:
438                     dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content = True
439                     continue
440 
441                 # Format content blocks for Bedrock API compatibility
442                 formatted_content = self._format_request_message_content(content_block)
443                 if formatted_content is None:
444                     continue
445 
446                 # Wrap text or image content in guardContent if this is the last user text/image message
447                 if idx == last_user_text_idx and ("text" in formatted_content or "image" in formatted_content):
448                     if "text" in formatted_content:
449                         formatted_content = {"guardContent": {"text": {"text": formatted_content["text"]}}}
450                     elif "image" in formatted_content:
451                         formatted_content = {"guardContent": {"image": formatted_content["image"]}}
452 
453                 cleaned_content.append(formatted_content)
454 
455             # Create new message with cleaned content (skip if empty)
456             if cleaned_content:
457                 cleaned_messages.append({"content": cleaned_content, "role": message["role"]})
458 
459         if filtered_unknown_members:
460             logger.warning(
461                 "Filtered out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks from messages, consider upgrading boto3 version"
462             )
463         if dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content:
464             logger.debug(
465                 "Filtered DeepSeek reasoningContent content blocks from messages - https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/reasoning_model#multi-round-conversation"
466             )
467 
468         # Inject cache point into cleaned_messages (not original messages) if cache_config is set
469         cache_config = self.config.get("cache_config")
470         if cache_config:
471             strategy: str | None = cache_config.strategy
472             if strategy == "auto":
473                 strategy = self._cache_strategy
474                 if not strategy:
475                     logger.warning(
476                         "model_id=<%s> | cache_config is enabled but this model does not support automatic caching",
477                         self.config.get("model_id"),
478                     )
479             if strategy == "anthropic":
480                 self._inject_cache_point(cleaned_messages)
481 
482         return cleaned_messages
483

507     def _format_request_message_content(self, content: ContentBlock) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
508         """Format a Bedrock content block.
509 
510         Bedrock strictly validates content blocks and throws exceptions for unknown fields.
511         This function extracts only the fields that Bedrock supports for each content type.
512 
513         Args:
514             content: Content block to format.
515 
516         Returns:
517             Bedrock formatted content block.
518 
519         Raises:
520             TypeError: If the content block type is not supported by Bedrock.
521         """
522         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_CachePointBlock.html
523         if "cachePoint" in content:
524             return {"cachePoint": {"type": content["cachePoint"]["type"]}}
525 
526         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_DocumentBlock.html
527         if "document" in content:
528             document = content["document"]
529             result: dict[str, Any] = {}
530 
531             # Handle required fields (all optional due to total=False)
532             if "name" in document:
533                 result["name"] = document["name"]
534             if "format" in document:
535                 result["format"] = document["format"]
536 
537             # Handle source - supports bytes or location
538             if "source" in document:
539                 source = document["source"]
540                 formatted_document_source: dict[str, Any] | None
541                 if "location" in source:
542                     formatted_document_source = self._handle_location(source["location"])
543                     if formatted_document_source is None:
544                         return None
545                 elif "bytes" in source:
546                     formatted_document_source = {"bytes": source["bytes"]}
547                 result["source"] = formatted_document_source
548 
549             # Handle optional fields
550             if "citations" in document and document["citations"] is not None:
551                 result["citations"] = {"enabled": document["citations"]["enabled"]}
552             if "context" in document:
553                 result["context"] = document["context"]
554 
555             return {"document": result}
556 
557         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_GuardrailConverseContentBlock.html
558         if "guardContent" in content:
559             guard = content["guardContent"]
560             guard_text = guard["text"]
561             result = {"text": {"text": guard_text["text"], "qualifiers": guard_text["qualifiers"]}}
562             return {"guardContent": result}
563 
564         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ImageBlock.html
565         if "image" in content:
566             image = content["image"]
567             source = image["source"]
568             formatted_image_source: dict[str, Any] | None
569             if "location" in source:
570                 formatted_image_source = self._handle_location(source["location"])
571                 if formatted_image_source is None:
572                     return None
573             elif "bytes" in source:
574                 formatted_image_source = {"bytes": source["bytes"]}
575             result = {"format": image["format"], "source": formatted_image_source}
576             return {"image": result}
577 
578         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ReasoningContentBlock.html
579         if "reasoningContent" in content:
580             reasoning = content["reasoningContent"]
581             result = {}
582 
583             if "reasoningText" in reasoning:
584                 reasoning_text = reasoning["reasoningText"]
585                 result["reasoningText"] = {}
586                 if "text" in reasoning_text:
587                     result["reasoningText"]["text"] = reasoning_text["text"]
588                 # Only include signature if truthy (avoid empty strings)
589                 if reasoning_text.get("signature"):
590                     result["reasoningText"]["signature"] = reasoning_text["signature"]
591 
592             if "redactedContent" in reasoning:
593                 result["redactedContent"] = reasoning["redactedContent"]
594 
595             return {"reasoningContent": result}
596 
597         # Pass through text and other simple content types
598         if "text" in content:
599             return {"text": content["text"]}
600 
601         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ToolResultBlock.html
602         if "toolResult" in content:
603             tool_result = content["toolResult"]
604             # Normalize empty toolResult content arrays.
605             # Some model providers (e.g., Nemotron) reject toolResult blocks with
606             # content: [] via the Converse API, while others (e.g., Claude) accept
607             # them. Replace empty content with a minimal text block to ensure
608             # cross-model compatibility. This follows the same pattern as the
609             # TypeScript SDK's _formatMessages in bedrock.ts.
610             tool_result_content_list = tool_result.get("content") or [{"text": ""}]
611             formatted_content: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
612             for tool_result_content in tool_result_content_list:
613                 if "json" in tool_result_content:
614                     # Handle json field since not in ContentBlock but valid in ToolResultContent
615                     formatted_content.append({"json": tool_result_content["json"]})
616                 else:
617                     formatted_message_content = self._format_request_message_content(
618                         cast(ContentBlock, tool_result_content)
619                     )
620                     if formatted_message_content is None:
621                         continue
622                     formatted_content.append(formatted_message_content)
623 
624             result = {
625                 "content": formatted_content,
626                 "toolUseId": tool_result["toolUseId"],
627             }
628             if "status" in tool_result and self._should_include_tool_result_status():
629                 result["status"] = tool_result["status"]
630             return {"toolResult": result}
631 
632         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ToolUseBlock.html
633         if "toolUse" in content:
634             tool_use = content["toolUse"]
635             return {
636                 "toolUse": {
637                     "input": tool_use["input"],
638                     "name": tool_use["name"],
639                     "toolUseId": tool_use["toolUseId"],
640                 }
641             }
642 
643         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_VideoBlock.html
644         if "video" in content:
645             video = content["video"]
646             source = video["source"]
647             formatted_video_source: dict[str, Any] | None
648             if "location" in source:
649                 formatted_video_source = self._handle_location(source["location"])
650                 if formatted_video_source is None:
651                     return None
652             elif "bytes" in source:
653                 formatted_video_source = {"bytes": source["bytes"]}
654             result = {"format": video["format"], "source": formatted_video_source}
655             return {"video": result}
656 
657         # https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_CitationsContentBlock.html
658         if "citationsContent" in content:
659             citations = content["citationsContent"]
660             result = {}
661 
662             if "citations" in citations:
663                 result["citations"] = []
664                 for citation in citations["citations"]:
665                     filtered_citation: dict[str, Any] = {}
666                     if "location" in citation:
667                         filtered_citation["location"] = citation["location"]
668                     if "sourceContent" in citation:
669                         filtered_source_content: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
670                         for source_content in citation["sourceContent"]:
671                             if "text" in source_content:
672                                 filtered_source_content.append({"text": source_content["text"]})
673                         if filtered_source_content:
674                             filtered_citation["sourceContent"] = filtered_source_content
675                     if "title" in citation:
676                         filtered_citation["title"] = citation["title"]
677                     result["citations"].append(filtered_citation)
678 
679             if "content" in citations:
680                 filtered_content: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
681                 for generated_content in citations["content"]:
682                     if "text" in generated_content:
683                         filtered_content.append({"text": generated_content["text"]})
684                 if filtered_content:
685                     result["content"] = filtered_content
686 
687             return {"citationsContent": result}
688 
689         raise TypeError(f"content_type=<{next(iter(content))}> | unsupported type")
690

910     def _convert_non_streaming_to_streaming(self, response: dict[str, Any]) -> Iterable[StreamEvent]:
911         """Convert a non-streaming response to the streaming format.
912 
913         Args:
914             response: The non-streaming response from the Bedrock model.
915 
916         Returns:
917             An iterable of response events in the streaming format.
918         """
919         # Yield messageStart event
920         yield {"messageStart": {"role": response["output"]["message"]["role"]}}
921 
922         # Process content blocks
923         for content in cast(list[ContentBlock], response["output"]["message"]["content"]):
924             # Yield contentBlockStart event if needed
925             if "toolUse" in content:
926                 yield {
927                     "contentBlockStart": {
928                         "start": {
929                             "toolUse": {
930                                 "toolUseId": content["toolUse"]["toolUseId"],
931                                 "name": content["toolUse"]["name"],
932                             }
933                         },
934                     }
935                 }
936 
937                 # For tool use, we need to yield the input as a delta
938                 input_value = json.dumps(content["toolUse"]["input"])
939 
940                 yield {"contentBlockDelta": {"delta": {"toolUse": {"input": input_value}}}}
941             elif "text" in content:
942                 # Then yield the text as a delta
943                 yield {
944                     "contentBlockDelta": {
945                         "delta": {"text": content["text"]},
946                     }
947                 }
948             elif "reasoningContent" in content:
949                 # Then yield the reasoning content as a delta
950                 yield {
951                     "contentBlockDelta": {
952                         "delta": {"reasoningContent": {"text": content["reasoningContent"]["reasoningText"]["text"]}}
953                     }
954                 }
955 
956                 if "signature" in content["reasoningContent"]["reasoningText"]:
957                     yield {
958                         "contentBlockDelta": {
959                             "delta": {
960                                 "reasoningContent": {
961                                     "signature": content["reasoningContent"]["reasoningText"]["signature"]
962                                 }
963                             }
964                         }
965                     }
966             elif "citationsContent" in content:
967                 # For non-streaming citations, emit text and metadata deltas in sequence
968                 # to match streaming behavior where they flow naturally
969                 if "content" in content["citationsContent"]:
970                     text_content = "".join([content["text"] for content in content["citationsContent"]["content"]])
971                     yield {
972                         "contentBlockDelta": {"delta": {"text": text_content}},
973                     }
974 
975                 for citation in content["citationsContent"]["citations"]:
976                     # Emit citation metadata, only including fields that are present
977                     # Nova grounding may omit title/sourceContent
978                     citation_metadata: CitationsDelta = {}
979                     if "title" in citation:
980                         citation_metadata["title"] = citation["title"]
981                     if "location" in citation:
982                         citation_metadata["location"] = citation["location"]
983                     if "sourceContent" in citation:
984                         citation_metadata["sourceContent"] = citation["sourceContent"]
985                     yield {"contentBlockDelta": {"delta": {"citation": citation_metadata}}}
986 
987             # Yield contentBlockStop event
988             yield {"contentBlockStop": {}}
989 
990         # Yield messageStop event
991         yield {
992             "messageStop": {
993                 "stopReason": response["stopReason"],
994                 "additionalModelResponseFields": response.get("additionalModelResponseFields"),
995             }
996         }
997 
998         # Yield metadata event
999         if "usage" in response or "metrics" in response or "trace" in response:
1000             metadata: StreamEvent = {"metadata": {}}
1001             if "usage" in response:
1002                 metadata["metadata"]["usage"] = response["usage"]
1003             if "metrics" in response:
1004                 metadata["metadata"]["metrics"] = response["metrics"]
1005             if "trace" in response:
1006                 metadata["metadata"]["trace"] = response["trace"]
1007             yield metadata
